proposal.title: Golden Harvest Reverie
proposal.idea: A generative wheatfield sunset responds to acoustic guitar and vocal melodies, evoking a sanctuary of peace and reverence.
proposal.geometry: Layered, overlapping planes of golden wheat stalks create a sense of depth and movement, responding to audio cues.
proposal.typography: Noto Serif for the lyric text, Outfit for a second line, and Cinzel for a final flourish.
proposal.imageLogic: The wheat stalks respond to audio, with intensity and form evolving as the music swells or slows.
proposal.texture: Simulated wheat grain texture with soft gradients and subtle bokeh, mimicking real-world textures with a cinematic edge.
proposal.motion: A subtle, graceful wave-like movement in the wheat stalks, with gentle sway responding to the audio.
proposal.productionMethod: Generative image and video models create the scene, controlled by audio parameters.
proposal.humanTrace: Simulated light, subtle grain, and a tactile material weave reflect the gentle flow of light on a golden wheat field.
proposal.risk: The potential for a generic visual may be minimized by the emphasis on specific textures and unique grain patterns that are rooted in a detailed simulation.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist may desire a more dramatic approach to the visuals.  This approach prioritizes subtle movement and visual calm over a grander, more theatrical effect.
